hero.title: The EU-native, ESCO-based, explainable Skills & Org Intelligence platform for the regulated mid-market
hero.subtitle: Govern skills, positions and organizational capability on a European public standard (ESCO) with auditable, AI-Act-ready recommendations.

esco.title: ESCO-native, open
esco.body: An EU public standard: no proprietary lock-in, cross-country benchmarking, interoperability.

explain.title: Explainable = AI-Act compliance
explain.body: Every recommendation (succession, flight-risk, gap) is deterministic and auditable before a regulator. No black-box.

position.title: Position-centric model
position.body: The position is a first-class entity: org-design and the structure↔process↔skill link that ERPs charge a fortune for.

icp.title: Who it's for
icp.body: European mid-market, 250–2000 employees, in structured and regulated sectors: banking, insurance, healthcare, utilities.

credibility.title: Built on standards, not promises
credibility.body: ESCO (European Commission) as the skills ontology, deterministic heuristics instead of opaque ML, a position-centric data model: every number traces back to its source.

form.title: Book a demo
form.subtitle: Tell us about your organization — we'll get back to you for a guided demo.
form.name: Full name
form.consent: I consent to my data being processed so you can contact me (see <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>).
form.success: Thank you! We'll be in touch soon.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: Pursuant to Art. 13 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), we provide the following information.
privacy.dataCollected: We collect the data you submit via the contact form: full name, company, work email and, optionally, role and message.
privacy.purpose: Your data is processed solely to respond to your demo request and to contact you about Heuresys services.
privacy.legalBasis: The legal basis for processing is your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
privacy.retention: Data is retained for the time strictly necessary to handle your request and, in any event, no longer than 24 months from collection. You may withdraw consent at any time by writing to the address below.

whistleblowing.title: Whistleblowing reporting channel
whistleblowing.legalNotice: This channel is reserved under Italian Legislative Decree 24/2023, handled solely by the designated custodian. No identifying data is stored, except for a contact you choose to leave voluntarily.

form.title: Submit a report
form.subtitle: The report is anonymous by default — leaving a contact is optional.
form.contactHint: You can stay fully anonymous by leaving this field empty. If you fill it in, the contact is visible only to the designated custodian.
form.successBody: Your report has been received by the designated custodian.
form.trackingCodeHint: Keep this code: it is the only way to follow the case.
form.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts — wait a few minutes and try again.

validation.subjectLength: The subject must be at least 3 characters long.
validation.bodyLength: The description must be at least 10 characters long.

status.title: Check your report status
status.subtitle: Enter the tracking code you received when you submitted the report.
